bundle.shortDescription: Find and clear caches, build output and leftovers across your Mac.
bundle.longDescription: MacClean is a native macOS utility that scans for safe-to-remove caches, build artefacts and developer leftovers, then lets you review and delete exactly what you choose. Every filesystem operation is validated by a Rust safety engine — protected system paths are never touched, and deletion is only ever permitted for items discovered in the current scan.
